description: PLATEAU's C02 building fixture read with only buildings and windows extracted, then written back. A window's parent gml:id names its building, as the wall between them is not extracted, and a building cannot hold a window, so window W1 is written as a top-level core:cityObjectMember instead of in wall WS1's bldg:opening (citygml.parent_cannot_hold is reported; pinned by unit tests, as workflow tests compare files only). Extract every level between, as hierarchy_extract does, to keep the nesting. New-world only: the legacy writer writes each feature top-level.
